reason: BBGraP is a model- and device-agnostic black-box graph partitioner that generates data-parallel execution plans for deep-learning inference across heterogeneous nodes, removing redundant transfers and synchronization for a 30% latency reduction on three nodes; it is distributed inference partitioning, but demonstrated only as a proof of concept on generic DNNs, not LLMs.
title: A Black-Box Graph Partitioner for Generalized Deep Neural Network Parallelization
